verdict.rationale: Training-data use is a fair privacy question for a hosted inference and fine-tuning platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no opt-out, no zero-data-retention setting, and no contractual commitment that customer prompts or data are excluded from model training. The only related item is a community complaint about vague privacy-policy language, which does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
